title: 📣 Baltimore Sales & Marketing Jobs with Multiple $70K+ Roles - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Baltimore’s sales and marketing scene is busy right now—lots of territory, account, and communications roles with solid pay and growth paths. Here are several strong openings worth a serious look.
Territory Business Manager, Dermatology – Baltimore Employer: Organon
Location: Baltimore, MD (covers Baltimore, DC & Northern VA)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $85,000 – $144,100 annually
Lead dermatology sales across a multi-city territory, building relationships with physicians and driving product awareness. Ideal if you have 2+ years of specialty/medical sales, love field work, and want a high-earning, fast-paced role.
Communications Manager (SNF Agora Institute) Employer: The Johns Hopkins University
Location: Hybrid / Homewood Campus, Baltimore, MD
Type: Full-time
Salary: $75,135 – $131,510 annually (commensurate with experience)
Own communications and marketing for a high-profile institute—strategy, media, branding, digital content, and events. Great fit if you have 5+ years in communications/marketing and want a visible role with leadership impact.
Sales Operations Consulting Senior Manager Employer: PwC
Location: Baltimore, MD
Type: Full-time
Salary: $124,000 – $280,000 annually + bonus eligible
Senior consulting role leading sales and customer strategy projects for major clients. Best for someone with 7+ years in sales operations/strategy who likes analytics, AI-enabled tools, and managing high-performing teams.
Industrial Territory Sales Engineer Employer: Schneider Electric
Location: Baltimore, MD
Type: Full-time
Salary: $115,200 – $172,800 (base + short-term incentives)
Blend technical know-how with channel sales, helping distributors and industrial customers design automation and power solutions. Strong match if you’ve sold through distribution and know VFDs, sensors, controls, or similar tech.
Mortgage Retail Sales Consultant (SAFE) Employer: Wells Fargo
Location: Baltimore, MD
Type: Full-time (commission + hourly base)
Salary: Hourly base (meets/exceeds minimum wage) + commission
Outside mortgage sales role sourcing residential loans and managing clients end-to-end. Great if you have 2+ years mortgage sales, are NMLS-ready, and want relationship-heavy work with strong benefits.
Senior Branch Premier Banker – Northeast Maryland District Employer: Wells Fargo
Locations: Multiple branches in Baltimore & Northeast MD
Type: Full-time (licensed or license-pending)
Pay Range: $34.00 – $60.00 per hour + incentives
Manage a book of affluent clients and provide holistic banking, lending, and investment guidance. Good fit if you’ve got 4+ years of customer-facing finance experience and can obtain/maintain FINRA and insurance licenses.
Business Development Representative (Account Executive – New Business) Employer: Galls
Location: Baltimore, MD (territory: MD, DC, Northern VA)
Type: Full-time
Hunt for new public safety and military accounts—high-volume outreach, meetings, and pipeline growth. Ideal if you have 2–4 years B2B sales/prospecting and like a pure “hunter” role with travel in the region.
Regional Sales Manager (Medical Device) Employer: Sales Recruiters Chicago, Inc. (for a medical device company)
Location: Based in Baltimore, MD (multi-state territory)
Type: Full-time
Manage an established medical device territory across MD, DE, parts of PA and NJ—serving surgeons, ophthalmologists, dentists, and hospitals. Great for experienced outside reps who enjoy travel, in-person demos, and long-term account growth.
Digital Creative Strategist Employer: Warschawski
Location: Baltimore, MD
Type: Full-time
Hands-on digital ads role focused on Meta campaigns, data-driven testing, and creative direction at scale. Good fit if you’re strong in spreadsheets, performance metrics, and giving clear direction to designers.
Director of Development Employer: Hope Ignites Baltimore
Location: Baltimore, MD (in person)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 per year
Lead all fundraising strategy and donor relationships for a local nonprofit with a $1.03M annual goal. Best for someone with 5+ years nonprofit development experience and deep comfort owning donor portfolios and CRM strategy.
Intern Employer: Morgan Stanley
Location: Baltimore, MD
Type: Part-time, internship (max 10 months)
Pay: $20/hour
Entry-level wealth management internship with exposure to marketing, sales support, and market research. Great for college students 18+ who want hands-on experience in financial services.
Sales – Entry Level (Sales Development Representative) Employer: Synerfac Technical Staffing
Location: Hunt Valley / Baltimore, MD area
Type: Full-time, on-site (Mon–Fri, 8am–5pm)
Projected Earnings: $45K–$65K (Year 1) , $60K–$90K (Year 2) , $75K–$125K (Year 3)
Perfect starter sales role: heavy cold calling, prospect visits, and meeting-setting for a tech staffing firm. Good if you have a bachelor’s degree, strong people skills, and want uncapped commission growth.
Leasing Professional – Alta Federal Hill Employer: Greystar
Location: Federal Hill, Baltimore, MD
Type: Full-time, onsite (flex schedule incl. weekends/holidays)
Pay: $19.00 – $20.00/hour + potential bonuses
Front-line leasing role handling tours, applications, renewals, and resident relations at a modern community. Nice match if you like sales plus customer service and want solid PTO and benefits.
